title: You Swallowed the Sun
translation: The sun, thousands of yojanas away: you swallowed it, thinking it was a sweet fruit.
translation_hi: हज़ारों योजन दूर स्थित सूर्य को आपने मीठा फल समझकर निगल लिया।

words.meaning: yuga (an age, also read as a number)

science: A popular reading: yuga (12,000) × sahasra (1,000) × yojana (about 8 miles) = 96 million miles, close to the real Earth-Sun distance of about 93 million miles. It's a fun coincidence rather than proof, since the length of a yojana varies between texts.
